design_description: A Calanques d'Ensuès-la-Redonne-inspired design built around layered Mediterranean blues. The upper jersey uses an energetic tone-on-tone brush texture, transitioning into an illustrated coastal scene with the sea, harbour, viaduct and surrounding landscape across the lower front. The back continues the painterly blue treatment in lighter sea-blue shades, while crisp white collar, cuffs, name and number provide contrast. Matching solid-blue shorts keep the focus on the scenic jersey artwork.
